body:
OBSERVED 2026-08-29 by reading the shipped surfaces on origin/main.

WHAT IS MISSING

  * frontend/src/pages/GlobalLibrary.tsx is 136 lines and has NO selection mode at all - its only
    <select> is the sort dropdown. Each card carries onAddToLibrary and adds ONE book per click.
  * frontend/src/pages/Catalog.tsx has a full multi-select mode and a BulkBar, but BulkBar's actions
    are: Add to shelf, Apply metadata, Edit metadata, Mark read, Mark unread, Merge, Delete. There is
    NO "Remove from my library".
  * The API is single-book only: PUT and DELETE /api/v1/books/<book_id>/my-library. There is no batch
    endpoint, so even the existing single-book path cannot be driven efficiently by a script.
  * The classic templates have no bulk membership control either.

WHY THE ADD DIRECTION MATTERS. The feature's stated purpose is curating a large archive - "thousands
of books where one person only ever reads a few dozen". The operator's own described workflow for a
real household member is: empty her personal library, then pull books in from the global library.
With no bulk add that is one click per book, and it is the exact path a new user of this feature
takes. Seeding hides the problem for accounts that start full and prune; it does not help anyone who
starts empty.

WHY THE REMOVE DIRECTION IS A HAZARD, NOT JUST A GAP. The single-book design is careful to separate
the two destructive-looking actions: different place on the page, different heading, different
wording, different confirmation - "Remove from my library" versus "Delete from the global library".
In multi-select that separation DISAPPEARS. A user who selects thirty books intending to prune their
own selection finds exactly one removal-shaped control, and it is:

    Delete {n} book(s)? This cannot be undone.

which erases the files for EVERY account. It is correctly gated on delete_books + edit and correctly
warns, so this is not a mislabelled button - the hazard is that the safe action a user is looking for
is absent, so the only thing that matches their intent is the irreversible one. BulkBar receives no
library-mode information at all (Catalog passes only ids, onClear, onChanged), so it cannot currently
adapt its wording or offer the safe alternative.

FIX SHAPE
  1. A batch membership endpoint accepting a list of book ids, applying the SAME per-book policy as
     user_library.add_book / remove_book (never a bulk bypass of the visibility and role rules), and
     returning a per-book result so partial failure is reportable rather than silent.
  2. Selection mode in Global Library reusing the existing multi-select components rather than a
     parallel implementation, with "Add to my library" as its bulk action.
  3. "Remove from my library" in BulkBar for accounts in personal-library mode, with the same
     confirmation content the single-book dialog now uses, placed away from Delete.

Do NOT let (3) become a second delete path, and do not let (1) become a way to add books an account
could not add one at a time.
title: My Library has no bulk membership action in either direction, and in multi-select the only removal-shaped button is the irreversible global Delete
